mentions.name: Kaggle seismic subsurface model prediction
mentions.description: A Kaggle competition entry that uses deep learning to predict subsurface models—maps of the geologic layers beneath a given area—from seismic data. The author is using it as a learning exercise connected to a physical problem, digging into how seismology works alongside the deep learning.
